macOS CI release executable and binary-only tar.gz. This newly imported target previously used the upstream baseline, which excludes fork remote ownership, pooled display, clipboard and Web behavior. Establish its first measured fork baseline; retain the 5% warning and 10% block thresholds.

Windows CI release executable and binary-only ZIP produced by upload-rust-binary-action. Refresh the cumulative baseline after owner HTTP/WebSocket forwarding, desktop App projections and browser control were added since b1ee9637. The executable grew by 3,906,048 bytes (+20.06%) and the ZIP by 1,168,389 bytes (+17.41%); this imported desktop batch adds no Rust dependencies. Retain the 5% warning and 10% block thresholds. Windows is checked in CI but is not an asset in the three-platform fork CLI release.
